properties.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 14 at 11:16AM PDT until October 18 at 12:00AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Northeast to east winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts 50 to 60 mph
expected. Strongest winds on mountain foothills.

* WHERE...Riverside County Mountains.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Thursday to midnight PDT Saturday Night.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds will blow down trees and power lines.
Widespread power outages are expected. Travel will be difficult,
especially for high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest winds will be on Friday. Winds
become more easterly Saturday.
properties.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind.

NWSheadline: HIGH WIND WARNING IN EFFECT FROM 6 AM THURSDAY TO MIDNIGHT PDT SATURDAY NIGHT
